definitions.explanation: Happening or changing in small increments over time; not suddenly.

examples.japanese: {天気|てんき}が{徐々|じょじょ}に{回復|かいふく}してきた。
{徐々|じょじょ}に{日本語|にほんご}が{上手|じょうず}になった。
examples.english: I gradually got better at Japanese.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{徐々|じょじょ}に{信頼|しんらい}を{得|え}ていった。

notes:
{徐々|じょじょ} uses the kanji {徐|じょ} (slow/gradual) repeated.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {徐々|じょじょ}に + verb (gradually ~)
- {徐々|じょじょ}に{変|か}わる (to change gradually)
- {徐々|じょじょ}に{増|ふ}える/{減|へ}る (to gradually increase/decrease)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {徐々|じょじょ}に: gradually (formal, written)
- だんだん: gradually (casual)
- {次第|しだい}に: gradually (formal)
- {少|すこ}しずつ: little by little

USAGE NOTES:
- More formal/literary than だんだん
- Can also be used as a no-adjective: {徐々|じょじょ}の{変化|へんか} (gradual change)
